name: Make coach-bubble visual flows deterministic in release Maestro CI
description: Restore scheduled native light/dark coach-bubble coverage with deterministic LLM completion and per-flow theme setup instead of timing on chat-input visibility.
acceptanceCriteria:
1. Hosted Maestro provides a deterministic coaching response through a test-only provider boundary.
2. The runner applies each flow's requested light or dark UI mode before app launch.
3. Both coach-bubble flows wait on a real response-complete oracle and assert readable coach copy.
4. Both flows pass on an Android release APK and can remove their blocked tags.
